skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and describe the characteristics, processes, and organizational structures of accounting in various internship units.
Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and propose improvements in accounting practices and systems within internship units.
Effectively communicate and write professional reports related to accounting in internship units.
Utilize information technology in the process of writing reports, including organizing and managing documents, using software for drafting and calculations.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively, showing adaptability and professionalism in work.
Show initiative and responsibility in work, both individually and as part of a team.
Conduct research and present findings in a structured and logical manner, providing evidence-based recommendations.
